description: This PHP source file defines a class for upgrading the Revive Adserver to version 5.0.0-beta-rc1, including methods for migrating configuration settings and database tables related to ACLs and geotargeting.

classes.name: RV_UpgradePostscript_5_0_0_beta_rc1
classes.description: A class responsible for upgrading the Revive Adserver to version 5.0.0-beta-rc1, including configuration and database table migrations.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main method to perform the upgrade, including starting a transaction, migrating configuration and tables, and rebuilding ACLs.

methods.description: Updates configuration settings, particularly related to MaxMind GeoIP settings.

methods.name: migrateTable
methods.description: Handles migration of specific database tables and their ACL rules, including updating, deleting, and reordering rules.
